TAKEAWAY

GOD’S WRATH IS A REVELATION OF LIVING LIFE WITHOUT HIM.


⸻

DIVISION 1 — 1.	MAN SUPPRESSES GOD’S REVELATION OF HIMSELF – ROMANS 1:18-20

Principle

Human wickedness and rebellion justify God’s wrath.

Application Question

WHAT TRUTHS ABOUT GOD WERE/ARE YOU TEMPTED TO SUPPRESS IN YOUR WALK WITH GOD? WHY?

[30-SECOND COUNTDOWN]

⸻

DIVISION 2 —	MAN EXCHANGES GOD’S REVELATION FOR IDOLATRY & DEPRAVITY                       
                                                                 Romans 1: 21-27
                                                             Principle

GOD WILL DELIVER YOU OVER TO THE DESIRES OF YOUR HEART.

Application Question

WHAT SIN DO YOU BATTLE WITH THAT KEEPS YOU FROM DRAWING CLOSER TO HIM?

[30-SECOND COUNTDOWN]

⸻

DIVISION 3 — MAN RECEIVES THE FRUIT OF THEIR IDOLATRY 

Romans 1:28-32

Principle

Saving faith in Jesus Christ overcomes sin’s inherited corruption.

No application question / countdown after Division 3.
